faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Jamui Support Person recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DCPU Jamui Support Person recruitment is 16-08-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Support Person post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in Social Work (MSW), Sociology, Psychology, Child Development, or Law. Alternatively, a Graduate degree in any discipline with a Diploma in Child Rights/Counselling and three years of experience is also accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Support Person position?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 30 years, and the maximum age limit is 65 years for the Support Person post. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Support Person post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 15 vacancies for the Support Person post announced by the District Child Protection Unit Jamui.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Support Person role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Support Person role is Rs. 9000/- per case, which includes remuneration and travel expenses.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the DCPU Jamui Support Person recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an evaluation of educational qualifications, carrying 80 marks, followed by an interview which accounts for 20 marks.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the DCPU Jamui Support Person jobs?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply offline by downloading the application form from the official website, filling it correctly, attaching necessary documents, and sending it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the Support Person positions at the District Child Protection Unit Jamui are contractual appointments.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, which includes a link to the official website of DCPU Jamui.
